caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a simple, rustic design. The chair is composed of four cylindrical legs, three horizontal slats forming the backrest, and additional horizontal supports at the base connecting the legs for stability. The seat of the chair appears to be flat and slightly darker brown compared to the lighter, grayish-brown color of the wood used for the legs and back slats. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no other objects present. There are a few small, reddish-brown stains or marks above the chair, and at the bottom right of the image, the name "Dorothy Johnson" is written in small, neat lettering.
title: Rawhide-bottom Chair
